currentOfficialMetadata.biography: 西晋贤相，张良的十六世孙，贾南风时辅政。与羊祜[hù]善。司马炎与羊祜谋划伐吴时，群臣唯张华、杜预赞成其计。羊祜临终将伐吴之遗志托付于张华、杜预。贾充曾在伐吴半进时进谏退兵并奏斩张华，司马炎护之。斩蛇剑穿屋而飞、干将莫邪双剑化龙、龙光射牛斗之墟皆出自其典。
currentOfficialMetadata.characteristic: 通过不断重铸牌造成伤害，需注意在牌多时不能正常用牌。

historicalOfficialLaunch.rawRelevantHtml:
时进谏退兵并奏斩张华，司马炎护之。斩蛇剑穿屋而飞、干将莫邪双剑化龙、龙光射牛斗之墟皆出自其典。 技能 【弼昏】：锁定技，当你使用牌指定其他角色为目标时，若你的手牌数大于手牌上限，你取消之并令唯一目标获得此牌。

【剑合】：出牌阶段，每名角色限一次，你可以重铸至少两张同名牌或装备牌，令一名角色选择一项：1.重铸等量张与之类型相同的牌；2.受到你的1点雷电伤害。 

【穿屋】：锁定技，当你造成或受到伤害后，你失去武将牌上前X个技能直到回合结束（X为你的攻击范围），然后摸与失去技能数等量张牌。 获取 2023-4-29 00:15:00~2023-5-6 23:59:59，幸运翻翻乐活动随机获取，或翻翻乐积分*4800(首周八折)兑换。

注：张华后续上线恢复原价翻翻乐积分*6000。

 

武将福利

活动时间：2023-4-29 00:00:00~2023-5-6 23:59:59，完成相应任务，即可获得奖励，累计限完成1次。

engineMappingsExplicitlyNotOfficialFAQ.subject: BiHun unique target and cancellation
engineMappingsExplicitlyNotOfficialFAQ.decision: At declaration freeze original primary target list; cancel other-role primary targets when post-cost actual Hand exceeds current HandLimit. Transfer all still-valid real use materials only if the original primary list had exactly one other-role target. Never infer unique from the count remaining after cancellation. Self-only effects remain native.
engineMappingsExplicitlyNotOfficialFAQ.basis: Current text establishes cancellation and unique target; original-list timing is explicit root mapping.

engineMappingsExplicitlyNotOfficialFAQ.subject: JianHe materials and peer matching
engineMappingsExplicitlyNotOfficialFAQ.decision: Both sides use native real Hand/Equipment recast. Owner group >=2 is all Equipment or one native canonical name; ordinary/Fire/Thunder Slash share name. No mixed Basic+Trick or Basic+Equipment group and no mixed-category histogram. Peer pays equal count of the single group category or takes Thunder1. Self selectable.
engineMappingsExplicitlyNotOfficialFAQ.basis: Direct current iIi/YFt/VFt/base target and card-row evidence.

engineMappingsExplicitlyNotOfficialFAQ.subject: JianHe per-recipient usage
engineMappingsExplicitlyNotOfficialFAQ.decision: Each living recipient, including owner, may be selected once in each real Play phase; extra Play phase has a new phase key. No global once-per-phase or per-turn cap. Freeze accepted target and obligation through native cost/draw children.
engineMappingsExplicitlyNotOfficialFAQ.basis: Current text says 出牌阶段，每名角色限一次; client hasTouchIds proves per-target set but exact server reset is not public.

engineMappingsExplicitlyNotOfficialFAQ.subject: ChuanWu ordered prefix after prior loss
engineMappingsExplicitlyNotOfficialFAQ.decision: Take first X of currently owned printed skill IDs, preserving original printed slot order; previously lost entries do not occupy prefix positions. Remove all currently owned grants matching those selected IDs and count distinct IDs actually removed.
engineMappingsExplicitlyNotOfficialFAQ.basis: Root explicitly selected mapping after correction; current public client proves slot order and physical removal, not the server prefix algorithm. Unverified external channel guide describes default range1 first losing BiHun then JianHe, retained only as secondary conflict signal.

engineMappingsExplicitlyNotOfficialFAQ.subject: ChuanWu damage count and self damage
engineMappingsExplicitlyNotOfficialFAQ.decision: Once per positive actually applied damage event whose source or recipient is owner; self damage does not double-dispatch the same native damage. Repeated real damage may remove subsequent currently owned printed skills. LoseHp is not damage.
engineMappingsExplicitlyNotOfficialFAQ.basis: Text 造成或受到伤害后; exact self-event deduplication is root engine mapping, not located official FAQ.

engineMappingsExplicitlyNotOfficialFAQ.subject: ChuanWu freeze and restore
engineMappingsExplicitlyNotOfficialFAQ.decision: Freeze X from actual attack range before any selected skill removal, and freeze actual distinct removed count before native Draw. Issued Draw survives source loss. Restore exact removed grant identities at end of that actual turn; death or incompatible template skips restoration, and later source regrant must not duplicate original identities.
engineMappingsExplicitlyNotOfficialFAQ.basis: Text until turn end and draw lost skill count; precise lifecycle/identity semantics are engine mapping.
